column1: # Game profile of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (Switch, base game v0 + update 13.0.5 = v2031616). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Bandai Namco / Sora's engine (namespaces app, lib, phx, nu) on SDK 8.2.1 with NVN; modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk, the same sdk and movie builds as Catherine: Full Body.
# RomFS: everything in data.arc (17.6 GB, read by dm/gfx/tools/smash_arc.py: zstd files named by hash40) beside 14 NRRs. The fighter, item and common scripts are 98 NRO modules in data.arc

# (prebuilt:/nro/release/lua2cpp_<name>.nro, 193 MB) that the game loads with nn::ro::LoadModule (collected by dm/tools/nro_collect.py, embedded in the iOS app); the NRRs also list 666 earlier versions the archive still holds.
# Shaders: GLSLC outputs in the SSBH shader databases (.nushdb), BNSH in the effects (EFFN) and UI layouts (SARC), and 77 in main

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# only the merged 13.0.5 copy is extracted
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; data.arc's current files, smash_arc.py) ----
